_doc: Hand-built skill_near similarities for tests (SPEC 5.2: cosine). Not real data. Format {skill id: {skill id: similarity}}; the matcher reads it both ways. Matcher 1.1.0 (owner decision O2) counts a pair only at 0.90 or more and only among the 3 closest neighbours of the skill it credits, so most pairs here no longer count; quality control to LLM evaluation was raised from 0.7 to 0.92 so swdev-qa-near still shows near at work.
